Entries.Original: Excuse me.
Can I help you, Vritika?
Uhm... I am here to talk to you about 31-X being dissolved and reassigned...
I beg your pardon?
The other day, I overheard you speaking to an officer. Is that idea...still on the table?
Vritika, do you want the squad to be dissolved?
Absolutely not!
31-X has many problems, and we are not always the most united squad, but even so, it...it is where I belong!
Different origins mean different viewpoints. Oftentimes, your lack of unity leads to setbacks.
But that is precisely why I believe you have a sort of strength only your squad can achieve. Keep up the good work.
Haan... Thank you, Commander.
(Before I know it, the seasons turn, and the wind blows pleasant... The temperature must be 20 degrees or so. Japanese autumn. A season India lacks.)
(Yesterday, 31-X tightened the bonds of unity the commander speaks of.)
(I am sure that from now on, we will perform according to our status as an elite unit with recruits from all over the world.)
(And as the New Delhi Branch's representative, I will conduct myself accordingly so as to not bring shame to my country.)
Nuooooh! When will it be my turn to cook?!\nI demand Chinese cuisine!
We keep tellin' ya, Chinese is way too much oil for breakfast!
I mean, if you want to talk about spoiling your stomach for the day, burgers and pizza are definitely up there..
I will kill you.
Aaaaah, frightfully sorry!\nPizza is ideal breakfast food!
Decide quickly who makes breakfast. I must go to Ruka.
(...As ever, they tug each other in opposing directions.)
(But even so, they all get mad together, fight together, laugh together...)
(This is 31-X. My dear, precious friends...)
Oh, Vritika is here! Vritika, you are the deciding vote! You have been craving Chinese cuisine recently, have you not?!
If you want a breakfast that really knocks your sock off, gotta be burgers!
If you want a balanced breakfast, you go with pizza.
The Full English breakfast is a delight, you know?
Pirozhki is easy to eat.
Yes, but I think...
We can mix all of those into kari.
